blurb: Ambleside Par 3 is a scenic family-friendly 18-hole pitch-and-putt golf course located in Ambleside Park. It offers waterfront views and is open daily from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. The course provides club rentals, lessons, and hosts small group tournaments.
extraNote: No refunds or rainchecks once starting golf; speak to staff for emergencies · Payment accepted by credit and debit card only · No alcohol, smoking, or vaping allowed · Tournament bookings are no longer accepted · Ambleside Par 3 at 900 Par 3 Road in Ambleside Park · Open March to October
